{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check for presence of control arm and moderate severity
print(f"Unique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique severity levels: {df['severity'].unique()}")

# Check if 'responded' is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'responded': {df['responded'].unique()}")

# Check if there are any patients in control arm with moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients (raw): {len(control_moderate)}")

# Check if any patient_id appears multiple times
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Patients with multiple entries: {duplicates.index.tolist()}")

# Inspect the top few duplicate patient_ids
print("\nTop 5 duplicate patient_ids and their sample_seq:")
df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq']).head(10)"}
